# Arjun Varadiyil

AI Engineer & Full Stack Developer in Kerala.
Ships Next.js and Payload CMS products for newsrooms, festivals, and civic programmes.
Builds AI agent and RAG workflows alongside production TypeScript systems.

## Projects

**Kochi Muziris Biennale**
Festival CMS — curators publish exhibitions and programmes through the season.
https://arjunvaradiyil.in/projects/kochi-muziris-biennale

**Prajasakti News Portal**
Telugu newsroom stack — same-day stories without engineering tickets.
https://arjunvaradiyil.in/projects/prajasakti-news-portal
https://prajasakti.com/

**Deshabhimani News Portal**
Malayalam daily — Payload-powered desk with a Next.js reader.
https://arjunvaradiyil.in/projects/deshabhimani-news-portal
https://www.deshabhimani.com/

**My Vote My Voice — Idukki**
Civic pledge, booth lookup, and election resources for district administration.
https://arjunvaradiyil.in/projects/my-vote-my-voice-idukki
https://myidukki.com/
